title.narrative: Provision of emergency lifesaving WASH response packages to drought-affected IDPs in Deynile District of Banadir region, Somalia

description.narrative:
ltpgtltpgtThe number of people affected by drought has more than doubled since the beginning of 2022. As per the 2023 HNO, drought-induced displacement has increased fivefold since the beginning of 2022 with more than 1.3 million people displaced. Five regions including Banadir have received the biggest numbers of newly displaced people. About 95 percent live in urban areas where humanitarian conditions are dire and where spikes in displacement have strained the capacity of the humanitarian system to cope. The displaced have joined newly formed IDP sites or existing over-crowded settlements further putting immense pressure on the limited basic services.lt/pgt
ltpgtTo respond to the crisis, prevent further displacement, and avert the risk of famine in Mogadishu IDPs, PAH aims to deliver a life-saving WASH response that reduces acute WASH needs among most vulnerable IDPs including men, women, boys, and girls in a dignified manner in compliance with cluster response minimum standards. In line with the WASH cluster and SHF, standard allocation 1, 2023, priorities the project will deliver WASH assistance to 14,286 IDPs (2,857 men, 3,857 women, 3,286 boys, 4,286 girls), including 2143 people with disability will directly benefit from this intervention.lt/pgt
ltpgtltbrgtPAH will focus on both immediate and sustainable intervention that includes:ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
ltpgt-improved access to safe water to 2,381 households by engaging community-owned boreholes to provide water to drought and conflict-affected IDP settlements in Banadir region, particularly Deynile district. This intervention is required due to the scarcity of safe water, increased water prices caused by the continued drought, and the additional influx of IDPs. PAH will carry out the construction of new water infrastructures equipped with appropriate storage systems, tanks, and distribution networks, provision of spare parts (pipes and generators), establishment and capacity development of gender-balanced water management committees, for ensuring the continuity of WASH services, and water treatment and monitoring (chlorination of communal water sources/HHWT).lt/pgt
ltpgt-Installation of 150 new sanitation facilities in IDP sites ONLY that is culturally appropriate safe for users of all ages and gender, and accessible to persons with disability equipped with handwashing facilities (at least 15% of facilities (23) should be accessible to PwDs). PAH will undertake a safe traditional desludging activity targeting both new and existing latrines constructed by PAH as well as other partners in Deynille IDP Camps.ltbrgtThrough engaging casual workers, a septic tank will be dug near the latrine pit for emptying PAH will ensure the environmental aspects related to latrine desludging adhere and the Casual workers will be equipped with tools to undertake the desludging activity (wheelbarrow, spade, Soap, buckets) and protective gears provided for safety purposes. lt/pgt
ltpgt-Addressing the need for improved hygiene practices through promotion campaigns focusing on disease prevention (including AWD/Cholera), provision of sanitation tools for solid waste management activities, and Hygiene kits distribution to 1500HHs, including female-specific hygiene items (sanitary materials).lt/pgt
